notes: First Habsburg to be crowned Holy Roman Emperor; from his long reign the Habsburgs held the empire continuously.

events.label: Victory at the Battle of Guinegate
events.labelCn: 吉内加特战役获胜
events.note: The victory helped secure the Burgundian inheritance for the Habsburgs.

events.label: Imperial Reform at the Diet of Worms

events.labelCn: 与雅盖隆家族的维也纳双重联姻
events.note: The agreements paved the way for Habsburg succession to Hungary and Bohemia.

sourceNote: Son of Frederick III; the marriages he arranged built the Habsburg dynastic empire. Core chronology completed 2026-08-20.
notes: Holy Roman Emperor whose marriage alliances made the Habsburgs the dominant dynasty of Europe.

deathCause.detail: Maximilian I died at Wels on 12 January 1519 after a long illness.
deathCause.detailCn: 1519年1月12日，马克西米利安一世在韦尔斯久病后去世。

notes: Son of Maximilian I and father of Karl V; king of Castile by marriage to Joanna, linking the Habsburgs to Spain.

sourceNote: Son of Philip I; ruled an empire on which the sun never set. Core chronology completed 2026-08-20.
notes: Holy Roman Emperor and King of Spain who ruled an empire spanning Europe and the Americas.

deathCause.summary: Died of natural causes at Yuste
deathCause.detail: After abdicating in favour of his brother Ferdinand and son Philip, Karl V retired to the monastery of Yuste in Spain, where he died on 21 September 1558, probably of malaria; he had long suffered from gout.
deathCause.detailCn: 卡尔五世逊位后隐居于西班牙尤斯特修道院，于1558年9月21日去世，可能死于疟疾；他长期受痛风困扰。
